title: The Real Cost of a 3D-Printed Hypercar
description:
What does a three-D-printed hypercar really cost? The reported price of a Czinger 21C is one point seven million dollars. But that is the price tag, not the cost. The cost includes thousands of hours of labour, a company that has raised hundreds of millions of dollars, and years of delay. We pulled every number our sources give, and we show where they stop. Our sources are Backfire News, via Yahoo, from March twenty twenty-four; GTPlanet, from February twenty twenty; Wikipedia's pages on the Czinger 21C and the McLaren Senna; CSQ; ASME; Autocar and GoAuto. Where numbers conflict, we show both. Our own arithmetic is labelled, and anything the sources do not say is flagged as not stated.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
